findings.description: The 'deterministic' terminal transcript for the text-analyzer example claimed 'Символов: 35', 'Уникальных слов: 6', and "Самое частое слово: 'is' — 2 раз(а)" for the input 'Python is great and python is fun' — all three values are factually wrong; the correct values (independently verified by direct execution, and already matching this project's own graders 12-11.py/12-12.py) are 33 characters, 5 unique words, and 'python' as the most frequent word.
